Definition
[asymptotic scalar curvature ratio definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 41.1\group Kleiner–Lott Kappa Solutions

For a complete connected Riemannian manifold, $\mathcal R=\limsup _{x\to \infty }R(x)d(x,p)^2$ is the asymptotic scalar curvature ratio, independent of $p$.
